audio_checks.scope: Only self-generated PCM, FFmpeg copy and deterministic threshold interval arithmetic. Not Claude/librosa or natural-music validation.
Only self-generated PCM, FFmpeg copy and deterministic threshold interval arithmetic. Not Claude/librosa or natural-music validation.

reproduction.input: 4 seconds, 8000 Hz, mono signed 16-bit PCM. Pulse sample is 12000 for first 8 samples of each 4000-sample block, otherwise zero; silence all zero.
reproduction.checks: Read output WAV metadata; SHA-256 input before/after; repeat same command with output already present and verify stderr plus unchanged output hash. Simple pulse BPM = 60 / median consecutive rising-edge interval, null when no intervals. This does not test natural music or librosa.
reproduction.timeline: Require 0 <= start < end <= duration, start equals previous end, first start 0 and final end equals duration; reject overlap, gap, negative start, zero-length and overrun.
